name: github-agent-skills
description: Eight evidence-based GitHub workflows for inspection and local preparation with human authorisation for remote actions.

interface.longDescription: Eight workflows for repository audits, README editing, profile curation, release preparation, issue drafting, issue implementation, branch review and pull request descriptions. Remote actions need explicit human authorisation.
